title: {Syn} Genetic Algorithms Search by Selection and Mutation
content:
Genetic algorithms maintain a population of candidate solutions, score them with a fitness function, and create new candidates through selection, crossover, and mutation.

They are useful when gradients are unavailable or the search space is awkward, but they still depend heavily on representation and fitness design.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
